title: Torrentflix
appDescription: Torrentflix: a classic Netflix TV style app for older LG TVs running webOS 4 such as the 2018 UK6300. Sources come only from Torrentio, shown as the top 3 by seeds for each resolution (4K, 1080p, 720p and other). Playback runs through your own Stremio streaming server such as Umbrel. No Stremio account is needed, and signing in is optional for your list and watch progress sync. Includes seasons and episodes, subtitles, playback speed and next episode.
